Jared Carreño is a senior engineering major at [Harvey Mudd College](https://hmc.edu) with a focus on mechatronics and embedded design. With hands-on experience in renewable energy (Ohmium), consumer audio (Harman), and laboratory automation (Trilobio), combining mechanical analysis (FEA/CFD) with electrical implementation (PCB & Hardware Design/Firmware) to deliver robust, full-system engineering solutions.
